title: Radix DLT Rust SDK
description: Development of native Rust SDK and tools for the Radix decentralized network, implementing off-ledger primitives that previously only existed in JS/TS.
functions: Core & Cryptography: Implementation of ROLA proofs verification (Login with Radix), key management (Keystore), and transaction building.
P2P Connectivity: Development of modular transport clients using WebRTC and Iroh for direct and secure communication with the mobile Radix Wallet.
AI & MCP: Creation of `radixdlt-connector-mcp`, a local MCP server that allows AI agents to build and send transactions to the user's mobile for signing, without exposing private keys.
